The [Federal Open Market Committee](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/banking/article/federal-open-market-committee-140029594.html) (FOMC) — a division of the Federal Reserve responsible for setting monetary policy — will soon meet again to evaluate the health of the economy and make key decisions regarding the [federal funds rate](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/mortgages/article/federal-funds-rate-194457132.html). _Read more:_[_Why you should open a CD account before the Fed's next meeting_](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/banking/article/should-you-open-a-savings-account-cd-before-fed-meeting-231620735.html). Due to rising [inflation](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/banking/article/inflation-definition-195527231.html), experts believe that the Fed will not reduce the federal funds rate again in 2026. Here's what to expect.](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/banking/article/what-time-is-the-fed-meeting-120032257.html "What time is the Fed meeting?").

## ​The next scheduled FOMC (Federal Open Market Committee) meeting will be on April 28–29, 2026. The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meets eight scheduled times a year to discuss and set monetary policy, and its decisions have a major impact on financial markets, mortgage rates, and economic growth. ## What is the FOMC? The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) is the branch of the Federal Reserve responsible for setting monetary policy for the US. ## What date is the next FOMC meeting? The Federal Reserve has scheduled its next FOMC meeting for April 28–29, 2026. See below for the full list of 2026's scheduled FOMC meetings:. At the end of each meeting, the FOMC announces its decisions on U.S. interest rates, followed by a press conference led by the Federal Reserve Chair. At its **March 18, 2026** meeting, the FOMC **kept the target range for the federal funds rate unchanged** **at 3.50% to 3.75%**. ## Will the FOMC / Fed cut rates in 2026?
